timing: Recorded before any full-logits intervention feasibility test and before any clean59 functional comparison
fixed_site: first clean59 trajectory in frozen order, first generated input token, first GDN layer
full_path_zero_injection_parity: maximum absolute full-vocabulary logit difference <= 0.001 and KL <= 0.000001
resource_feasibility: Estimated lower bound for two interventions over all 44505384 token-layer observations on four GPUs <= 24 hours, and single-GPU peak allocated memory <= 23000 MiB
rule: If full-path parity fails, stop for diagnosis. If parity passes but resource feasibility fails, mark all clean59 full-logit quantities NOT_COMPUTED and report exact pilot-only KL/top1/margin separately. Do not substitute local projection metrics for KL.
scope: No outcome-based selection of trajectory, token, layer, horizon, threshold, or outlier
